//: Separate project for sw.js: it runs in a Service Worker global (self, clients, ServiceWorkerGlobalScope, PushEvent, NotificationEvent) which the DOM lib used by the root tsconfig.json for assets/js/ does not model (and conflicts with — both declare an incompatible `self`). @types/serviceworker supplies those types; TS ships no built-in service-worker lib. Being the nearest tsconfig.json to assets/sw.js, this is the project typescript-eslint's projectService resolves for it; `npm run typecheck` also invokes it directly.
